summary: The idea was right and the plan called it: your pre-market wanted 9:30 to go lower to send price higher, your 5min Scenario A drew the retrace into the OTE and the push through the high, and that's exactly what happened. You went long around 10:00 at 28,308.75 with the stop at 28,248.00 under the 0.786 / internal low and the target at 28,441.25 (2.18R, matching your logged RR), and price hit that target at about 11:03 AM. On the XFA you closed at breakeven around 10:40 AM because the chop got to you ('my cortisol is spiking'), and price ran a couple of minutes later. The bigger issue is that you copied the same trade onto your evals and treated them as accounts you 'did not care if i lost on', then filed the End of Day card with 'Rules Followed: Yes'. Check-in was on time at 9:18 with the risk screenshot confirmed, there was no Asia trading, and Gmail shows no new eval or account purchases today.
trade: Long · NY-AM · XFA + Eval (copied) · XFA BreakEven, Eval Win · entry 28,308.75 around 10:00 AM after the OTE .786 rejection · stop 28,248.00 under the 1min internal low near the 0.786 (60.75 pts, later trailed) · target 28,441.25 at NYAM.H / toward the 4hr UMG (132.5 pts, 2.18R, matching the logged RR) · XFA closed at BE about 10:40 AM, target hit about 11:03 AM. Risk 1 micro.
rule: Tomorrow, trade one account only: no copying the trade onto evals. Before entering, write where you'd move to BE (a specific level or structure break, not a feeling), and if price is still between entry and stop in chop, leave the stop alone.

fix: You copied the trade onto your evals and wrote you 'did not care if i lost on it'. That's two sets of rules for one idea, and it's the copy-trading pattern that blew accounts last week. One account, one plan.

Your EOD card says 'Rules Followed: Yes' but doesn't mention the eval copy trade or the emotional BE. The card only works if it's honest; the improvement line ('not to sure yet') should have said what actually happened.
You went BE on the XFA because of chop and annoyance, not because your own BE condition (ES taking its external high) happened. Decide the BE trigger before entry and stick to it.
The stop at 28,248.00 is only a couple of points under the 0.786 wick low. Give it a few ticks more buffer below the protected low.
Reflect and What i can improve on are empty in Notion. Fill them in tonight while the 'two minutes later' feeling is fresh.

questions.q: You wrote you 'did not care if i lost on' the evals but went BE on the XFA. If you didn't trust the trade enough to hold it on the account that matters, why was it good enough to put on the evals at all?
Your own chart note said 'i need to see ES hit external high to go BE', but you closed because 'it was chopping' and your 'cortisol is spiking'. Did ES actually hit that high before you closed?
Your EOD card says 'Rules Followed: Yes'. Which of your rules covers copying one trade onto several accounts, and would AB agree it was followed?

Your improvement line says 'Holding my trade even if we chop i guess not to sure yet'. What specifically would have had to happen for you to exit the XFA trade early, written as a level or a structure break?
